ALTER TABLE `allowed_emails` ADD COLUMN `allowed_pages` text;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `checklists` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `user_email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `is_team` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `reset_daily` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `checklists_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `checklist_items` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `checklist_id` int NOT NULL,
  `text` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `order` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `checklist_items_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `checklist_completions` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `checklist_item_id` int NOT NULL,
  `user_email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `completed_date` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
  CONSTRAINT `checklist_completions_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
